text:
mia: Quick note — I spotted /openapi/chat/generate examples in API ref using Content-Type: text/plain in curl and python snippets. That breaks client parsing (expect application/json). I'm opening a small docs PR to change to application/json and add a response snippet showing the envelope + choices. PR coming up.
sam: Thanks, can you post the exact file path so I can check the sample generator?
mia: Path: docs/api-ref/endpoints/chat_generate.md and docs/snippets/python/chat_generate_response.md
mia: Current curl block:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate" -H "Content-Type: text/plain" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
mia: Proposed change:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
alejandro: Also add an explicit short example of the JSON response body shape, e.g. `{"id": "r_123", "result": {"output": "Hello", "tokens": 12}}` so SDK users know what field to look for.
kate: Can we also call out that streaming SSE uses `text/event-stream` and leave that as-is? Otherwise people will try to set application/json for SSE and it breaks.
mia: Yup. Will update both examples and add a note in the "Response content type" section saying non-streaming endpoints return application/json. Will include a migration note for SDKs showing how to switch.
sam: SGTM. Do we need a changelog entry or is this docs-only?
docs-bot: PR created by @mia: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/8423 — reviewers: @alejandro @sam
mia: Assigning @kate for API product review, tagging @eng-ml for visibility re: streaming behavior :eyes:
kate: Reviewed, looks good. Added a minor wording tweak about error payloads (specifically that errors include `error.code` and `error.message`).
mia: Updated PR with wording change, added python snippet that parses JSON response and checks for `result` key:
```python
resp = client.post('/v1/chat/generate', json={'input': 'hi'})
body = resp.json()
if 'result' in body:
    print(body['result']['output'])
```
alejandro: lgtm
sam: Approving in GH
mia: Merged. Thanks everyone :tada:
